paper_id: SCAU-Net_ Spatial-Channel Attention U-Net for Gland Segmentation
title: SCAU-Net: Spatial-Channel Attention U-Net for Gland Segmentation
motivation: 手动分割医学图像耗时且需专家 pathologist，仅靠U-Net准确度不足
problem_framing: 腺体分割需增强局部相关特征、抑制空间与通道层面的无关特征
key_insight: 空间注意力和通道注意力可作为即插即用模块嵌入U-Net实现特征重校准
method_signature: 对称编码器-解码器结构 + 空间注意力模块 + 通道注意力模块
evaluation_criteria: Dice系数、Jaccard系数、RVD在GlaS和CRAG数据集上评估
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 注意力机制增加模型参数，数据量少时更易过拟合；未来需探索卷积层数等超参数设置
evidence_for_taste: only experts are able to identify tissues
fuzzy edge is the most worthy
pay more attention on the edges
the added attention mechanism makes the model parameters increase
the model is more likely to over-fit with less data amount
thinking_moves: 从U-Net基线出发逐步添加注意力模块验证增量贡献
可视化注意力权重图解释网络关注区域
分析训练曲线中过拟合现象与参数增加的关系
